description: R0-35-EXIT-PROOF binds R0-17-PAYMENT-TX-INTEGRITY's suites: the queue planned test/commerce-payment-integrity.integration.test.ts; the packet landed as R0-PL-03-PAYMENT-ATOMIC-RECONCILE, whose tests-first commit 41325fb8 created test/payments-manual.integration.test.ts instead, and invoice-workflow.service.spec.ts (the queue's tests_first). The queue planned this manifest under this name; it was never added, so R0-35 adds it. Every case that passed at the R0-35 head is required (131 cases); allowAdditionalCases is true so a later packet may add a case without editing this manifest, while a required case that is renamed, skipped, turned into a todo or deleted rejects the verdict, and a new skip or todo fails release0-proof-coverage.spec.ts until scripts/proof-admission/release0-index.json explains it. Run from the repo root: node scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs --only commerce-payment-integrity.json (or pnpm --filter server proof:release0 for every Release 0 manifest), against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL.
